insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
Chronic Renal Failure or end stage Renal Failure or Chronic liver failure
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED Coverage: 50% co-pay up to Rs.2 lakhs in 2nd & 3rd year (during 36-month PED waiting period). Not for 16 specified illnesses.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured. 4X Multiplier benefit for Life Threatening Conditions (up to 11X SI total with NCB+Reload)

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All Day Care Treatments covered up to SI; pre/post 30 days each

maternity_coverage.notes: Maternity not covered under Multiplier base plan.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs.5,000 per hospitalization (includes app-based cab cover)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Second Medical Opinion for 22 specified critical illnesses; 4X Multiplier Benefit available in Life Threatening Conditions (4 times in Policy lifetime)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Includes Cancer, Heart Attack, CABG, Heart Valve, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ Transplant, Paralysis, Motor Neuron, Multiple Sclerosis + 11 additional CIs.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Flexi Reload up to 100% of Base SI from 2nd claim onwards; available even for same illness same insured
restoration_benefit.notes: Once per policy year. Not for first claim.

copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary Co-payment options 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%. Zone 2 priced 20% lower than Zone 1.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Domestic only; emergency domestic evacuation covered up to Rs.100,000.

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas
temporary_exclusions: Pre-existing 36 months (50% co-pay PED rider available in years 2-3)
notable_exclusions_summary: Multiplier excludes maternity, infertility, OPD treatment, refractive error, and treatments outside India. The 4X Multiplier Benefit provides emergency cover up to 4 times Sum Insured plus NCB in Life Threatening Conditions, available 4 times during policy lifetime.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA in network hospitals; reimbursement claims by submitting documents. Settlement within 15 days of last document; 2% above bank rate for delay.
available_riders: Health & Wellness Plus (app, teleconsult, virtual health coach)
ABCD Benefit (Asthma, BP, Cholesterol, Diabetes inpatient PED 30+ days)
Hospital Plus (consumables + mobility devices up to Rs.50,000)
